title: Quentin and the Crown
author: Ada Voss
blurb: Mara Pemberton, a hedge-witch's runaway apprentice, keeps the ledgers of a guild that trades in impossible things. Then a dying stranger presses a map into unwilling hands — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now he must reforge a broken covenant between realms, and time is already running out.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
